profiles.description:
I am Leonn Trotsky. I am an agent of change.

In a universe of metal and scrap, gasses and gravity, oppression and miliatarization, I stand with those who would give control of our worlds back to those world's true heroes: the workers.

It takes scarce examination of our galactic power structures to note power doing as power does: consolidating, growing, and eventually resting its weight upon those with less means.

There is only one solution to this. Power does not cede to humanity's better nature. It is a beast controlled only by its lust to sustain and feed its insatiable appetite for further expansion. It can be tamed only by collective action. We must unite.

1/29/14 Capsuleer's log

I have put aside my studies to venture into the universe of action, one where I must die to be reborn, where I must endure the fires of the stars and become the man I know I am destined to be. Here I hope to find my strength and spread my message to the masses.

8/16/23 Capsuleer's Log

I'm back. That is all.
